notablePrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
You control lands that can tap to add at least {5}{R}{R}.
description:
Cast Firemind's Foresight by paying {5}{U}{R}, searching for Lightning Bolt, Reset, and Reiterate.
Cast Reset by paying {U}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Reset.
Resolve the Reset copy, untapping all lands you control.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite mana, you can cast Lightning Bolt by paying {R}, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Lightning Bolt.
Resolve the Lightning Bolt copy, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 7.
